{{Quote|Clan Vizsla is with you.|The warrior, to Bo-Katan Kryze|<ref name="Heroes" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] '''warrior''' of [[Clan Vizsla]] of [[House Vizsla]] pledged his [[Mandalorian clan]] to [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the [[Mandalorian resistance]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] along with several other Mandalorian factions during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|Mandalorian Civil War]] after she obtained the [[Darksaber]]. As a result of the [[Mandalorian warrior]]'s support for Lady Bo-Katan, she became [[Mandalore (title)|Mand'alor]].<ref name="Heroes" />
